      }, {
        "text": "**Analyzing Audio Setting Effects**\n\nI\u0027m now diving into the implications of this testing setup. Setting the \"Device Period\" to a low value, like 1ms, reduces audio latency. However, aggressive settings can cause issues. This variable overrides the default BASS audio engine buffer, making us balance latency reduction with potential sound card driver conflicts to prevent crackling or crashes.\n\n\n",

    }, {
      "text": "This notification indicates that **osu! (lazer) has detected an experimental audio environment variable** set on your system that overrides the audio engine\u0027s default buffer update interval (specifically the BASS audio engine\u0027s `BASS_CONFIG_DEV_PERIOD`).\n\n---\n\n### 1. What does \"Device Period\" mean?\n* **Audio Latency:** The device period determines how frequently (in milliseconds) the game feeds chunks of audio data to your sound device (like your HyperX Cloud III headset).\n* **Lower value \u003d Lower latency:** The default in the engine is typically 10 ms. Setting it to a lower value (such as `1`) attempts to drastically minimize the delay between your key presses and the hitsound output.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Why is it showing this warning?\n* **Experimental Feature:** The osu! development team added support for overriding this via an environment variable (`OSU_TEMP_TESTING_BASS_CONFIG_DEV_PERIOD`) so community members could test lower audio latency configurations before an official in-game UI slider is finalized.\n* **Potential Instability:** Forcing an ultra-low buffer/period (like 1 ms) can cause **audio crackling, pops, stuttering, desync, or game crashes/segfaults** if the audio driver or USB DAC cannot keep up.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Why is it active on your PC?\nYou (or an audio latency tweak script / optimization guide) added an environment variable to your operating system.\n\n---\n\n### 4. What should you do?\n\n* **If your audio sounds normal and the game is stable:**\n  You don\u0027t need to do anything. You are benefiting from reduced audio hitsound latency. You can dismiss the notification.\n\n* **If you experience audio crackling, cutouts, or crashes:**\n  You should remove or tweak the environment variable:\n  1. Press \u003ckbd\u003eWin\u003c/kbd\u003e + \u003ckbd\u003eS\u003c/kbd\u003e and search for **\"Edit the system environment variables\"**.\n  2. Click **Environment Variables...** at the bottom.\n  3. Look under both **User variables** and **System variables** for a variable starting with `OSU_` (such as `OSU_TEMP_TESTING_BASS_CONFIG_DEV_PERIOD`).\n  4. Select it and click **Delete** (or set it to a higher, more stable value like `5` or `10`), then restart osu!.",
